title.zh: ⚡️美媒：美军已被要求做好对伊朗恢复打击的准备
title.en: ⚡️美媒：美军已被要求做好对伊朗恢复打击的准备

current_state.zh: 美国官员称五角大楼已指示中央司令部准备恢复对伊朗的大规模军事行动，可能打击伊朗能源、基础设施和核设施；同时特朗普公开承诺不在中期选举前打击伊朗，但美军据报已向以色列通报可能月底前恢复行动，美伊谈判持续且美国维持封锁。
current_state.en: US officials say the Pentagon has instructed CENTCOM to prepare for resuming large-scale military operations against Iran, potentially targeting Iranian energy, infrastructure, and nuclear facilities; meanwhile Trump publicly pledged no strikes before the midterm elections, but the US military reportedly told Israel that operations could resume by the end of October, with US-Iran talks ongoing and the US maintaining its blockade.

updates.title_zh: 特朗普承诺美国中期选举前不会打击伊朗，但美军据报已向以军通报月底前恢复军事行动的可能性
updates.title_en: 特朗普承诺美国中期选举前不会打击伊朗，但美军据报已向以军通报月底前恢复军事行动的可能性
updates.what_changed_zh: 特朗普承诺美国不会在11月3日中期选举前打击伊朗；美军据报已向以色列国防军总参谋长通报可能在本月底前恢复对伊军事行动；若恢复打击，伊朗可能报复以色列并导致以色列选举推迟；美伊谈判被描述为富有成效，美国维持对伊封锁。
updates.what_changed_en: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the Nov 3 midterm elections; the US military reportedly told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran could resume by the end of October; if strikes resume, Iran may retaliate against Israel and delay Israel's election; US-Iran talks described as productive; US maintains blockade on Iran.
updates.current_state_zh: 美国官员称五角大楼已指示中央司令部准备恢复对伊朗的大规模军事行动，可能打击伊朗能源、基础设施和核设施；同时特朗普公开承诺不在中期选举前打击伊朗，但美军据报已向以色列通报可能月底前恢复行动，美伊谈判持续且美国维持封锁。
updates.current_state_en: US officials say the Pentagon has instructed CENTCOM to prepare for resuming large-scale military operations against Iran, potentially targeting Iranian energy, infrastructure, and nuclear facilities; meanwhile Trump publicly pledged no strikes before the midterm elections, but the US military reportedly told Israel that operations could resume by the end of October, with US-Iran talks ongoing and the US maintaining its blockade.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, even as reports say the US military has told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran—potentially targeting energy and nuclear sites—could resume by the end of October.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Trump pledged the US will not strike Iran before the November 3 midterm elections, even as reports say the US military has told Israel's military chief that operations against Iran—potentially targeting energy and nuclear sites—could resume by the end of October.
